explication: Exo is a Python-based exocompiler for writing and scheduling loop-oriented tensor procedures, then generating C and headers for target hardware. The principal workflow is author a procedure, transform it with scheduling operations, and compile it. Its internal layers include Python-to-LoopIR parsing, IR rewrites and analyses, and target-aware C code generation; memory models and hardware platform support provide important additional capabilities. Several relationships below are documented by the README or SOURCE INDEX; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
